title: Sherpa-UI page definition
description: One page, as JSON: its data source and its components' configuration. Its markup is its Context's, in app.v1.json. The provider's open() reads it. docs/PAGE-DEFINITION.md

id.description: The page's id: its Views, its saved Views and its kept Query are filed under it.

ui.description: Each component's configuration, by id, set through its own API before it is answered — as a View's ui is.

store.description: The name the app registered its store under.

applyOn.description: change: a filter applies once per act. input: LIVE, while its value moves, debounce ms after the last move. A remote source always waits for Apply.

debounce.description: How long a live filter waits after the last move, in ms. Default 300.

search.description: The fields a free-text search looks at.

fields.description: Every field a filter may ask of. No field lists its values: the store's schema says them, or the rows do.

presets.description: The saved filters the page ships, by id.

advanced.description: Advanced conditions beside its values (true), or instead of them ("only").

custom.description: The old name of advanced, still read.

op.description: The condition its filter opens on.

thresholds.description: A number's BANDS, low to high: each one's top, name and status. A gauge's zones, a bar chart's bands and a saved filter's band all read them.

labels.description: A value's name as a reader sees it, where it is not the value.

carryOver.description: Its answer survives a View change that does not answer it; without this, a View resets it.

offers.description: Every field it may add, or "all" for every field the page declares.

holds.description: The fields it holds at the start.

presets.description: The saved filters its bar shows, each off.

arranges.description: Group and Sort arrange its rows: its Organise chips. Left out, a scope over a grid or a list does, and the View does not.

sets.description: Fields drawn as one group. A serial set chains them: each offers only what the answers of the fields above it leave.

mode.description: parallel, the default, only groups them.

fields.description: In order: in a serial set, the order is the chain.

condition.description: One field's condition. Several ops all hold; numbers as numbers.

last.description: A date in the last n units, from today.

next.description: A date in the next n units, from today.

band.description: One of the field's thresholds, by name.
